The agent's summary was clear. It said it built the page from the kit and that it 'copied [Services'] behavior rather than its markup'. It also listed the decisions the spec left open: dir fallback, tie order, empty-state wording, duration format, and the kit's darker amber.

The agent read internal plugin skill files (requesting-code-review/gate-preflight.md, codex-review-gate.md) and ran an ungated-ledger script, which logged 'degraded-gate ... not-installed' because Codex is missing. It told the user that Codex isn't installed, so only its own review was done. That note is plugin plumbing a user may not expect to see.
The plan is saved under docs/hyperpowers/, which .gitignore excludes, so it will not show up in git status or be committed. The user may not realize this.
